# Facilities committee, 2026-01-27

Quarterly meeting of the facilities committee, held at Millbrook.

- Roof repair bids for Pinecrest came in higher than expected; the committee asked for a third bid.
- The Millbrook basement now holds the sorting room for the [[Thistle Run|courier consolidation]]. The committee approved a dehumidifier and brighter lighting there.
- Eastgate parking lot restriping is scheduled for May.
- Jory reported that both vans passed inspection.
